han_viet_wordlist.methodology: Traditional Chinese character readings classified by pinyin; the publisher cites Hán-Nôm, Hán Việt, Thiều Chửu, CC-CEDICT, and related dictionary sources.

unihan.kVietnamese_definition: The ideograph's pronunciation(s) in Quốc ngữ.
unihan.kVietnamese_caveat: Unicode does not distinguish Hán Việt from Nôm readings in this field; it is used here only as a cross-check or fallback.

steps: Copy every input record unchanged, including official names, source keys, and parent-set links.
Read each official Traditional Chinese name character by character.
Prefer a pinyin-specific reading from the pinned Hán Việt wordlist using Unicode kMandarin; otherwise use its wildcard reading, then Unicode kVietnamese, then a documented fallback.
Preserve Chinese punctuation and ASCII symbols, and title-case the generated Quốc ngữ syllables for display.
Attach the generated alias as additive metadata; never overwrite an official name or translation.

confidence_policy.high: All Han characters have one selected wordlist reading and no alternative candidate in the derivation.
confidence_policy.medium: All Han characters resolve, but one or more characters has multiple candidate readings and the first matched candidate was selected.
confidence_policy.low: A fallback, Unicode-only reading, or unresolved character is present; the raw character is retained when unresolved.
confidence_policy.whole_name_caveat: Even high-confidence aliases are generated character readings, not reviewed or official Vietnamese localizations.
